pkgmetadata.longdescription: utility scripts for joetoo systems, including in categories "iptools", "devtools", "converters", "router" joetoolkit supports amd64, arm64, and arm and has made efforts to design pdf-converters that will run on arm and arm64 or their ~ arch, however because some of the converters upstream dependencies are not keyworded for those arch, this package is not either. Nonetheless, you SHOULD be able to unmask the package and those dependencies with ~* or ** in package.accept_keywords and they should work, but to do so accept this "at your own risk" warning

use.flag: Install the pdf converter tool scripts
Install scripts required by a joetoo router/firewall/dns/ddns/vpn server
